name: AgentLens
description: Audits any website for the reasons AI assistants fail to find, read, quote or trust it, and for the reasons AI-referred visitors leave without engaging. Emits a single evidence-backed report of findings and prioritized fixes.

skills.owns: Site profiling, page sampling, invocation of the diagnostic skills, finding merge and suppression, severity arbitration, final report emission.
Stage 1 — the page was never reachable by an AI client. Robots directives, bot-vs-browser response parity, sitemap health, canonical and redirect integrity.
Stage 2 and 3 — the page was reached but the facts were not in the delivered HTML, or were present in a form that is not text.
Stage 4a — machine-readable claims are absent for a detected content pattern, malformed for their declared type, or contradict the visible page text.
Stage 4b — the prose is readable but contains no self-contained, attributable sentence an assistant could lift as an answer.
Stage 5 — the fact is quotable but carries no recency signal, is contradicted across the site, is corroborated nowhere off-site, or belongs to an ambiguous entity.
Stage 6 — the assistant-referred visitor arrived on a deep page and left. Answer continuity, deep-entry orientation, entry obstruction, delivery performance.
